game_concept: A tower defense set in Mt. Pyre – Obsidian Quarry, a glassy black quarry: the fire warden must hold off fire sprites while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Modulo Gate: Use % to decide which gates in Obsidian Quarry open (even, odd, divisible by 3).
theme: Mt. Pyre – Obsidian Quarry: a glassy black quarry
core_gameplay_loop: In Obsidian Quarry, repeat each round: Use % to decide which gates in Obsidian Quarry open (even, odd, divisible by 3). Then check gates_open and advance.
player_objective: Protect the fire shrine from fire sprites in Obsidian Quarry: keep gates_open above zero until the 36-second timer ends.
controls: Keyboard: SPACE applies the code fix; H shows a hint; mouse/touch: tap the code panel to choose a value.
learning_alignment: Week 2 – Data Types & Operators | Level 3 (intro tier): Modulo Gate
assets_style: pixel-art volcano: purple-black rock, glowing lava rivers, orange ember light, drifting ash; flat Kenney-style sprites; low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects
duplicate_check_notes: Generic fallback template for Week 2, Level 3, Standard. Deliberately a simple survival game; it is not one of the 2,700 unique pool games and is only used when no pool game can be served.
